_comment: Input to L1-inception-story-generator, BOM Phase 3 (Inception — just-in-time). Phase 3 elaborates ONLY the features the cycle planner committed for the near cycle, never the whole PI. Three inputs per the BOM row: cycle-plan.md says which features to elaborate now, features.json supplies those features and their AC, and functional_requirements supplies what the AC must trace back to.
_bom_note: Appendix A bands F1.1 as size M; Appendix C.5 works F1.1 as an 'L' and invokes the story-slice layer for it. This example follows C.5, because C.5 is the worked decomposition example and the collapsible-story rule needs both branches demonstrated. Flagged rather than silently reconciled.

definition_of_ready: Feature has acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form
Every acceptance criterion traces to a functional requirement id
Upstream feature dependencies are committed or already delivered
No open regulatory question blocks the feature's happy path
Architecture capability the feature needs is AVAILABLE in the platform capability register

elaboration_request.reason: Just-in-time: only the near cycle's committed features are elaborated. F3.2 and F2.1 are on the roadmap and are deliberately NOT sent here.

content.execution_summary: • Cycle 1 committed: F5.1, F1.1. Capacity 30 points, Squad A.

features.title: External identity-provider integration
features.needs_slicing_rationale: Fits one feature cycle (<= 5 days) on the decomposer's own fit test. No story layer is created; the feature's AC is carried forward directly.

acceptance_criteria.when: they authenticate through the group-approved external identity provider
acceptance_criteria.then: a session is established and no employee-directory credential is involved

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated external party with no role claim
acceptance_criteria.then: the party is provisioned with the role their onboarding record specifies, and no default elevated role is granted
the call is refused server-side and the refusal is not bypassable by altering the client request

features.title: Producer registration + FBO verification
features.needs_slicing_rationale: Size L — does not fit one feature cycle. The decomposer flags it; the story layer is invoked and each slice independently re-runs the fit test.

acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a registration with an FBO number
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration is accepted and held pending verification

acceptance_criteria.when: the FBO lookup returns a valid status
acceptance_criteria.then: the producer's registration becomes valid and publication is permitted

acceptance_criteria.when: the FBO lookup returns invalid or does not answer
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration is rejected, the producer is notified, and publication stays blocked
they have explicitly attested that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status

artifacts.name: features.json
artifacts.description: Feature decomposition with AC and needs_slicing flags

content.execution_summary: • 2 committed features passed to Phase 3. F5.1 needs_slicing=false; F1.1 needs_slicing=true.

functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status for any trade facilitated on the platform.

functional_requirements.title: FBO status verification
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall verify a producer's declared Food Business Operator registration against the competent authority's register before permitting that producer to publish a listing.

functional_requirements.title: External-party authentication
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate producers, distributors and foodservice buyers through a group-approved external identity provider, and shall not extend the employee directory to external parties.

content.execution_summary: • 3 functional requirements in scope for the Cycle 1 committed features.
